summary: Implemented passive homogeneous Lorentz, damped Drude, and passive homogeneous Debye medium support across the public API, typed IR, coefficient compilation, and the shared PoleResidue-family update path, with explicit tests for each family.
key_findings: `autofdtd.materials` now exposes `Lorentz`, `Drude`, and `Debye` models with analytical `eps_model()` evaluation, family-specific validation, and lowering to equivalent `PoleResidue` payloads.

`autofdtd.ir` now emits typed `LorentzIR`, `DrudeIR`, and `DebyeIR` payloads, and the compiler preserves the originating family tag while compiling onto the existing `PoleResidueMaterialCoefficients` auxiliary-state contract.

Compilation now fails explicitly when converted dispersive poles are too stiff for the current exact-hold timestep path, which clearly delimits the currently supported subset instead of emitting unusable coefficients.
Examples, docs, tests, and working memory were updated so the new families are exercised and the subset boundary is recorded for later material/runtime tasks.

artifacts.description: Added Lorentz, Drude, and Debye public models plus analytical-to-PoleResidue lowering helpers.
Extended Phase 1 medium dispatch and exports to include Lorentz, Drude, and Debye.
Added Lorentz, Drude, and Debye coefficient compilation on the shared PoleResidue runtime contract plus explicit stiff-pole rejection.
Added typed LorentzIR, DrudeIR, and DebyeIR lowering and medium dispatch integration.
Updated constitutive metadata so the shared dispersive kernel path reports Lorentz, Drude, and Debye support.
Added compiled analytical-dispersion examples covering Lorentz, Drude, and Debye lowering and coefficient generation.
Documented the added analytical dispersive families and the explicit stiff-pole compile rejection policy.
Added named Lorentz, Drude, and Debye validation, IR, compilation, and shared-kernel tests.
Recorded the new analytical-dispersion decisions and the stiff-pole subset boundary for later tasks.
Recorded the structured task result for this run.

follow_up_notes: Verification passed with `ruff check src tests`, `pytest -q tests/test_materials.py`, and `python -m compileall src`. A repo-wide `mypy src` run still reports pre-existing unrelated typing issues outside this task’s scope.
